challenge.method: Compare the scanned grammar and final-wait clause with §8.1 and the next-page note. Test a process without a sensitivity list and the related, separate case of a wait in a procedure parented by a sensitivity-list process. Check the VASG distinction between language and RTL synthesis standards.
challenge.results: The final implicit wait and explicit-wait ban apply to the stated sensitivity-list process. The standard separately addresses procedure parents and other wait forms. The adjacent note explains execution during simulation. VASG lists RTL synthesis separately.

limitations: This is the Language Reference Manual's process semantics. Procedure ancestry, later syntax, and synthesizability require separate findings.
